name: io.github.onlymoein/google-search-console-mcp
title: Google Search Console
description: Search Console analytics, hourly data, URL inspection and sitemaps, with guards for API quirks.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path to a service account JSON key. Leave unset to use the OAuth login from `open-gsc-mcp auth login`.

environmentVariables.name: GSC_ENABLE_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 0 to leave out the submit/delete sitemap and add/delete site tools.
